rationale: This file contains HLF transaction entrypoints (Init/Invoke) but only performs routing logic. All actual transaction logic is delegated to the external `card` package via cross-file calls (card.Create, card.GetByNumber, card.GetAll). Within this file, there are no C1-C4 or C6 patterns - no time.Now(), no goroutines, no map iteration, no rich queries, and no mutable global state. The fmt.Println calls are logging only and do not influence ledger writes or responses.
